testCase.name: [dev] S19 Native iOS and Android builds: traffic capture shows no cleartext, both modes

descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S19 Native iOS and Android builds: traffic capture shows no cleartext, both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere. (UAT OAT-02; UAT 4; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U2 All traffic is encrypted in transit. This includes the live-dictation audio stream and the backend's calls to the AI and email providers (Bedrock, Vertex, OpenAI, SES). (UAT OAT-02; TFA-92568 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. … (UAT OAT-02 step 3; UAT OAT-02; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given A TestFlight build and a Play internal build pointed at the deployment Q8 names, on an iPhone and an Android phone on a Wi-Fi with a recording proxy (or Android Studio Network Inspector / Xcode Instruments). Not on and never with store-review-test-account@roundcompanion.com. …

When Run the S01 walk in both modes on each phone, including real dictation and a census photo. Then, with a chart open: switch Wi-Fi → cellular, background and foreground the app, and restart dictation after each.

Then No cleartext HTTP from the WebView or the native plugins (speech, camera). Every host is reached over https://, wss:// or DTLS, also after the network switch and the background/foreground. Handoff and tasks offer no email or mailto on the phone.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-02 step 1 'every network request in the app' on iOS and Android. Any cleartext request = Fail, quoted with host, step and mode.

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
